description: The long-run (2001–2020) NASA POWER climatology for one 0.5° cell (about 55 km): global horizontal and direct normal irradiance in kWh/m²/day, wind speed at 50 m in m/s, air temperature in °C and aerosol optical depth at 550 nm (dust, and so panel soiling), each as an annual mean and by month. Ask by a tracked project id (answered for its locality, never its site), by a place given as "north,east" in decimal degrees, or by a cell id. Area-level only: it is not a site measurement and must not be quoted as a plant’s yield.

point.description: A place as "north,east" in decimal degrees; snapped to its 0.5° cell

project.description: A tracker project id (Saudi, GCC or captive), e.g. sudair-pv-1500-mw

name: solar_resource
title: Solar and wind resource for an area
